title: Heated Turkish Chicken Kebabs
description: These heated Turkish chicken kebabs deliver bold paprika flavor and a comforting, diabetic-friendly twist that's perfect for a quick, satisfying meal on a sick day.
instructions: Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a bowl, mix olive oil, paprika, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper to create a seasoning paste.
Add chicken cubes to the paste and toss until evenly coated.
Skewer the chicken cubes, leaving a little space between pieces for even cooking.
Place the skewers on the hot grill and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side until the chicken is fully cooked and slightly charred.
Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the cooked kebabs for brightness.
Remove the skewers, sprinkle chopped parsley on top, and serve immediately.
Enjoy with a side of grilled vegetables or a fresh salad for a balanced meal.
